prompt:
Create one production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a cozy Stardew-Valley-like pixel-art RPG. Reference image 1 is a contact sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT character identities, LEFT TO RIGHT: Toby, Momo, Jack, Lily, Ben, Frank, Daisy, Sam. Reference image 2 is the existing Toby sitting sprite style/proportion/pose reference. Retain each character's original hair, outfit colors, distinctive hat/glasses/beard/animal features. Convert all eight to the SAME small crisp 32x48-style seated pixel characters as Toby. Large clear single-pixel dark eyes, no blur or smoothing.
STRICT ATLAS LAYOUT: EIGHT equal-width columns, FOUR equal-height rows, total32 separated sprites, every column is ONE character in that exact order. Row1 facing DOWN toward camera, Row2 facing LEFT profile, Row3 facing RIGHT profile, Row4 facing UP away from camera (back of hair, NO eyes). All 32 poses truly SITTING on an invisible chair, knees bent at90deg, compact thighs and lower legs, hands on lap, feet below knees. No actual chairs, tables, shadows, labels, text, grid lines or extra items. Fixed identical scale and baseline in every equal cell, ample fully transparent gutters. Complete heads/hats and feet not clipped. Square pixel clusters with hard edges. GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND everywhere outside sprites, not a checkerboard image. Landscape canvas aspect ratio 2:1, each of8x4cells has same dimensions. Keep all character silhouettes separated and fully inside each equal cell. For Ghost retain white sheet sitting drape; God Eye remains single-eye robed figure; Old Fox retains fox head and tail. Only include these if in this batch's eight characters.
